The Goonie Prowl

Fort Lauderdale, FL · Tarpon River · Social · Cruiser

The Goonie Prowl is a social and cruiser group ride in Fort Lauderdale, FL. It rolls every Friday at 8:00 pm from Tarpon River Brewing. Pace: d, 12–14 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–14 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Goonie Prowl group ride

Friday night social ride out of a brewery. Slow pace, stops for beer and food, any bike works. Bring lights.
